english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things that are opposite or opposed, including directions.
This is the all-purpose choice for ideas, beliefs, or positions that are contrary or opposite.
This is the all-purpose choice for things that are contrary or extremely different.
Use this when one thing is directly opposite to another, such as an idea being contrary to common sense.
